retrievalProfile.description: A three-person group portrait with a large negative space header featuring a small central icon and split gradient typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three men in 1970s attire positioned in the lower half of the frame, set against a muted teal-grey background with a small orange biplane and bold, sunset-gradient block text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The subjects are clustered at the bottom, creating a heavy base for the composition.
The small biplane acts as a central focal point between the two words of the title.
The warm orange-to-yellow gradient in the text contrasts with the cool, desaturated background.
coreInvariants: Horizontal split of the title text
Soft, directional studio lighting on the subjects' faces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in the bottom 60% of the frame, shown from the chest up in a tight grouping.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central biplane illustration at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant top text, drop to the central plane, then settle on the detailed faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant empty space in the upper-middle section to separate the graphic elements from the photography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal-grey background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sunset gradients (orange, yellow, red) used for typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and earth-toned clothing (tan, white, plaid).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background and clothing allows the high-saturation text to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with horizontal striations.
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal linear texture or 'speed lines' integrated into the fill
Linear vertical gradient from yellow at the top to deep orange at the bottom
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sliced horizontally to create a shutter or blind effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face paired with a central illustrative logo.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed block weight for the 70s look.
Captures the industrial, heavy feel of the era's display type.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three men with 1970s hairstyles and fashion (mustaches, open collars, beret) against a solid muted teal-grey background, leaving the top 40% of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small orange biplane illustration in the top center. Add large, condensed block text on either side of the plane using a yellow-to-orange vertical gradient and horizontal line textures.

verificationChecks: Is the text split into two words with the plane in the middle?
Does the text have a horizontal striped texture?
Is the background a desaturated teal-grey?

mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the typography is condensed and heavy.
Verify the subjects are positioned in the lower half.
Confirm the gradient in the text is vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: 70s Group] + [Background: Muted Teal] + [Header: Split Gradient Block Text] + [Icon: Central Small Illustration]
